Class PlotMouseHandler

java.lang.Object
edu.cnu.mdi.splot.plot.PlotMouseHandler
All Implemented Interfaces:
MouseListener, MouseMotionListener, MouseWheelListener, EventListener
public class PlotMouseHandler extends Object implements MouseListener, MouseMotionListener, MouseWheelListener
Handles all mouse interaction for a PlotCanvas.

This class was extracted from PlotCanvas to keep that class focused on coordinate geometry, painting, and data management. All MouseListener, MouseMotionListener, and MouseWheelListener logic lives here.

Responsibilities

  • Legend and extra-text dragging (mousePressed(MouseEvent), mouseDragged(MouseEvent), mouseReleased(MouseEvent))
  • Mouse-move feedback: coordinate readout, histogram bin info, XY curve summaries, bar-plot hit testing, 2D histogram bin info (mouseMoved(MouseEvent))
  • Scroll-wheel zoom (mouseWheelMoved(MouseWheelEvent))

Canvas coupling

The handler holds a reference back to its owning PlotCanvas for coordinate transforms, data access, and repaint requests. It does not hold any state that could not be reconstructed from the canvas.

Author:
heddle (original), refactored for extraction

    • mouseWheelMoved

      public void mouseWheelMoved(MouseWheelEvent e)
      Zooms the canvas in or out using the scroll wheel.

      Base zoom factor is 1.12 per notch. Holding Ctrl/Meta gives finer control (1.04); holding Shift gives coarser control (1.20). The computed factor is clamped to [0.2, 5.0] as a safety net against runaway zooming.

      Specified by:
      mouseWheelMoved in interface MouseWheelListener
      Parameters:
      e - the mouse-wheel event
